topic: Zoro and Luffy both learned Haki, but Luffy got a teacher and a plan while Zoro got a sword that demanded everything
title: Why Zoro Never Learned Haki Like Luffy
description:
Luffy and Zoro both spent two years getting stronger, but their Haki came from completely different places. Luffy trained on Rusukaina with Rayleigh, while Zoro trained with Mihawk and then had his Conqueror's Haki forced out by Enma. I think that difference explains why Zoro's Haki still looks rougher and harder to hold. Do you think Zoro got his Conqueror's Haki from Mihawk, or did he earn it on his own?
